mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit margins and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises >0.3pp, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a contraction in aggregate demand that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint declines in HOUST and RSAFS fail to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO annualized growth <0.5%), a monthly decline in industrial production signals supply chain disruption that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO annualized growth <0.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past quarter signals stronger aggregate demand that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a tightening monetary policy that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increases fail to produce negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE >5.5%), a monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE >5.5%, PAYEMS declines fail to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts decline below 900,000 units signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST <900.0, SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
